judged_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:70-77 — `blacklistedGuestEmails` is lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but the incoming `guest` value from `guests.filter(...)` is never lowercased before `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`, and likewise `guest === attendee.email` at line 76 is a raw case-sensitive comparison, so a blacklisted address submitted with different casing (e.g. "Foo@Bar.com" vs blacklisted "foo@bar.com") bypasses the block, and the same guest with varied casing bypasses the existing-attendee dedup, creating a second attendee row that is semantically the same person .
